name: Flight 1
summary: The first integrated flight of Starship and Super Heavy lifted off from OLP-1 at Starbase on April 20, 2023. Several Raptor engines were out at or after liftoff and the booster lost thrust vector control about 85 seconds in, so stage separation never happened. The flight termination system was triggered and the still-attached stack broke up about four minutes after launch, after peaking near 39 km. The launch dug a crater beneath the pad, which led SpaceX to install a water-cooled steel flame deflector.
highlights: First integrated launch of Super Heavy B7 and Ship 24
Cleared the launch tower, the main stated goal
Three engines out before liftoff, more lost during ascent
Flight termination triggered around T+3:10; breakup around T+4:00
Pad damage drove the switch to a water-deluge steel plate

objectives.label: Booster controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico
Ship splashdown in the Pacific near Kauai

boosterFate: Destroyed by the flight termination system while still attached to the ship (about T+4:00).
shipFate: Destroyed with the booster before stage separation.
